name: Quick Pro GR:ONE GRX Di2 1×12
why_interesting: A race-oriented 45 mm-clearance GRX Di2 complete build with an official global price, complementing the published GR:ONE frameset.
missing: Map the exact mainland Taobao configuration labels and selected prices to their component packages
Mainland delivery, duties, returns, and warranty-handling confirmation
price_status: Current official US$4,799 global reference; no exact mapped mainland CNY checkout after 50 registered areas
required_before_dashboard: Mainland-China purchase route, dated checkout price, and local warranty evidence
source_note: Current exact global price remains US$4,799. The official mainland listing’s numbered options remain unmapped to the exact GRX Di2 1×12 bill of materials, so no CNY amount is promoted after 50 areas.

facts.frame_material: Toray T1100 + M65 high-strength and high-modulus carbon
facts.frame_construction: Monolith one-piece monocoque molding with fully internal routing and a carbon seatpost
facts.stiffness_evidence: An exact-model review reports noticeable designed flex at the seatpost cutout and a comfortable, fast ride; this is qualitative ride evidence, not a measured lateral-stiffness result
facts.frame_weight_basis: Current official mainland listing: size M including paint and frame accessories, ±5%; fork 459 g and seatpost 169 g are separate
facts.complete_weight_status: No exact complete-bike weight, size or weighing protocol found after 50 registered source areas; published frame, fork and seatpost weights are not summed

support_note: Official support page states a five-year frameset warranty for the original purchaser, one-year Shimano/SRAM coverage on complete bikes, mostly assembled delivery, and typical standard-bike delivery around three weeks; mainland-China service and delivery are not confirmed.
